proposal: (lead) probable F5('CHN', 'Jiangsu Binhai (Datang) Offshore wind farm', 'mp', url='https://www.offshorewind.biz/2019/06/17/ming-yang-reaches-turbine-milestone-at-chinese-owf/', ...) once a source covers all 96 turbines
note_zh: 線索：96 部（50 部明陽 3.0 MW＋46 部金風 3.3 MW；由 100 部優化為 96 部，國資委）。施工中（2019-06）offshorewind.biz 寫「機組正立在單樁上」，主承包為中交三航局；振華重工承做二標段 45 套基礎（樁長 79–86 m、最大管徑 6.5 m，世紀新能源網），未寫「單樁」。2016 年試樁時的方案是「單樁及高樁承台」（設計階段）。沒有出處逐座涵蓋 96 部，列線索。
note_en: Lead: 96 turbines (50 Mingyang 3.0 MW + 46 Goldwind 3.3 MW; optimised from 100 to 96, SASAC). During construction (June 2019) offshorewind.biz said the units “are being mounted on monopile foundations”, with CCCC Third Harbour as main contractor; ZPMC built lot 2’s 45 foundations (piles 79–86 m long, up to 6.5 m in diameter, ne21) without saying “monopile”. The 2016 test-pile stage planned “monopiles and high-rise pile caps” (design). No source covers all 96, so lead only.
why: No owner/contractor completion record or O&M tender with per-turbine foundations found; MSA notice (msa.gov.cn) returns 403; bjx/in-en blocked.

sources.quote: The units are being mounted on monopile foundations, which are said to have been chosen for cost optimization.
nearly 25 out of 50 MySE3.0-135 turbines have been installed at the project site until 15 June. The 300MW project will also comprise 46 3.3MW turbines provided by Jinfeng Technology.
由振华重工海工集团钢结构事业部承担45套风电基础的制作，海服集团承担45套风机基础的运输、安装及风机机组安装。 在45套风机基础中，基础桩设计长为79米至86米，最大管径6.5米
将风机总台数由100台优化为96台
风机基础拟采用单桩基础及高桩承台方案

item: R5. Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua): foundation type and depth
farm: Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm
proposal: (lead) probable F5('CHN', 'Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm', 'mp', ...) and D(... depth=(30, 32), url='http://www.chnenergybidding.com.cn/bidweb/001/001002/001002003/20250319/0abdddd0-e807-4b32-b13b-065fba68cdce.html') once a construction source is found
note_zh: 線索：71 部 8.5 MW（603.5 MW，一期 36 部、二期 35 部）；二期環評（公示稿）寫「本項目風機基礎為單樁基礎」，屬設計階段，不寫入。2025-03 國華投資的生態修復監測招標（建成後）寫場址水深 30–32 m，待基礎型式確定後可作 D 列。一期的基礎型式沒有任何出處。
note_en: Lead: 71 × 8.5 MW (603.5 MW; phase 1 36, phase 2 35); the phase-2 EIA (public draft) says the turbine foundations are monopiles, a design-stage source, not written. Guohua’s Mar 2025 ecological-monitoring tender (after completion) gives a site depth of 30–32 m, usable as a D row once the type is settled. Nothing found for phase 1’s type.
why: No construction, completion or O&M source with the foundation type; chnenergybidding searches (乳山, U2) found only the ecological-monitoring tender.

sources.quote: 场址面积95.6km²，水深30m~32m，场址中心离岸距离约32km，布置71台8.5MW风电机组，总装机容量为603.5MW。
本项目风机基础为单桩基础，总工期为 6个月。

item: R6. Tangshan Laoting Putidao: foundation counts
note_zh: 線索更複雜：75 部 4 MW；中交三航局做 15 座高樁混凝土承台（已知），華電重工 2017-11 簽約做 39 部風機的高樁承台基礎（offshorewind.biz，合同新聞），華西海工 2018-11 在此完成首個單樁。若華電合同照原樣施工則承台至少 15＋39＝54 座、單樁約 21 座，但先前北極星摘要稱華電簽的是「單樁風機基礎施工合同」，互相矛盾；沒有建成後的分型式座數，不寫入。
note_en: Lead, now more complicated: 75 × 4 MW; CCCC Third Harbour built 15 high-rise concrete pile caps (known); Huadian Heavy signed in Nov 2017 to build high-rise pile-cap foundations for 39 turbines (offshorewind.biz, contract news); Huaxi Offshore drove its first monopile here in Nov 2018. If the Huadian contract was built as signed there would be at least 15 + 39 = 54 caps and about 21 monopiles, but an earlier bjx summary called Huadian’s contract a monopile contract; no as-built split found, so not written.
why: Hebei natural-resources sea-use registration page (zrzy.hebei.gov.cn) returned 503; suntien.com not tried again; MSA notice 403.

sources.quote: Huadian Heavy Industries will be in charge of constructing the high-rise pile cap foundations for 39 offshore wind turbines to be installed off the coast of the Hebei province.
三航局负责15台高桩混凝土基础的土建及金属结构安装工程和75台单机容量为4.0兆瓦风机机组的安装，风电场装机总容量为300兆瓦。
2018年11月 华西5000在唐山乐亭菩提岛海上风电场项目中完成公司首个海上风电单桩基础施工

item: R7. Other farms touched this round (no new verifiable source)
farm: Huaneng Rudong H3; Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind farm; Xiexin (GCL) Rudong H15; Jiangsu Rudong H5 (Yunshan) Offshore wind farm; Huaneng Zhuanghe II; Zhuanghe I; CTG Changyi; Shandong Energy Bozhong B; Huaneng Peninsula North BW
note_zh: 如東 H2、H3、H5、H15：仍只有兩個標段各買單樁的線索；人民網 2021-10 寫如東 11 個子項目「風機單樁沉樁完成率 89.9%」，但三峽 H10 有 23 座複合筒，這種統稱不能當成逐場證據。如東採招網有「江蘇國信如東海上風力發電場風機單樁基礎及海上升壓站安全監測工程維保」的標題，正文抓不到。莊河Ⅱ：仍無單樁／吸力桶導管架座數（搜狐、中新網、界面只寫規模化應用）。莊河Ⅰ：龍船風電網的竣工驗收報導（16 單樁＋3 導管架吸力筒）仍回 403，找不到轉載。昌邑：EPC 招標寫「採用單樁基礎，樁徑 6.0–6.6 m」是設計值；三峽 2024 年報導（ctg.com.cn、cypc.com.cn 鏡像）TLS 中斷。渤中 B、半島北 BW：無新出處。
note_en: Rudong H2, H3, H5, H15: still only the lead that both lots bought monopiles; People’s Daily (Oct 2021) gives an 89.9% “monopile driving” rate for Rudong’s 11 sub-projects, but CTG H10 has 23 composite buckets, so this group wording is no per-farm evidence. A Rudong procurement listing has the title “Jiangsu Guoxin Rudong offshore farm turbine monopile foundations and offshore substation safety-monitoring maintenance”, but its body could not be fetched. Zhuanghe II: still no monopile / bucket-jacket counts (Sohu, Chinanews, Jiemian say only “at scale”). Zhuanghe I: the imarine completion-acceptance report (16 monopiles + 3 bucket jackets) still returns 403 and no repost was found. Changyi: the EPC tender’s “monopile foundations, 6.0–6.6 m piles” is a design value; CTG’s 2024 report (ctg.com.cn and the cypc.com.cn mirror) drops TLS. Bozhong B, Peninsula North BW: nothing new.
why: Blocked or unfetchable: sthjj.nantong.gov.cn and www.nantong.gov.cn (403/reset), rudong.gov.cn (503/403), wind.imarine.cn (403), msa.gov.cn (403), www.ctg.com.cn / www.cypc.com.cn (TLS EOF), sthj.shandong.gov.cn (503), zrzy.hebei.gov.cn (503), shanghai-electric.com (521). The CCER registry (ccer.cets.org.cn) is a JS app; its project documents were not explored.

sources.quote: 截至目前，该项目已完成全部海上升压站与换流站安装工作，风机单桩沉桩完成率达89.9%、吊装完成率达85.9%。
早在勘探阶段，项目部就发现，庄河场址北侧部分海域覆盖层浅、岩石层厚且存在岩溶钻孔现象，传统的海上风电单桩基础无法适用。
